tooltips.name: A human-readable label that identifies what this key is used for (e.g. "Chatwoot AI Agent", "Zapier integration").
tooltips.user: The CRM user this key authenticates as. Non-admins can only create keys for themselves.
tooltips.apiKey: Send as the `X-Api-Key` header on API requests. The plaintext value is only visible to the owner and to admins.
tooltips.isActive: When unchecked, the key stops authenticating immediately without having to be deleted.
tooltips.expiresAt: Optional expiry. If set in the past, the key stops authenticating regardless of `isActive`.
